name: Yamato Ayane
source:
An old friend of the protagonists who has since passed away.
She has been gone for ten years, but her presence has had a great impact on them all.

She had an innocent and strong personality, and was regarded as the leader of the village children.

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
